items.title: Skitch Henderson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Milford, Connecticut, October 31, 1998
items.q: I was trying to think of one conductor I worked for — he won the academy award once too, he did westerns, big westerns though, for Selznik.

ctx.x: Wow. It must have been very stressful.

Sometimes — I was trying to think of one conductor I worked for — he won the academy award once too, he did westerns, big westerns though, for Selznik. He used a big orchestra and scored to the screen, which was unheard of at that time, I mean this was, because this involved another union and eight more men in the studio. Nothing changes.
Yeah. I was just going ask about that.
